what_it_is: The Coyote Block 2 is RTX (Raytheon) expendable counter-drone interceptor - a small turbojet-powered munition that physically pursues and destroys hostile UAS, fielded by the US Army in large quantities and integrated with Ku-band radar and electronically scanned arrays.
india_angle: Coyote is the reference interceptor-class C-UAS solution globally; no Indian purchase is publicly confirmed. Its relevance here is architectural - Indian services are studying interceptor layers alongside jamming and guns for swarm defence.
